en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2260 - Abu Ja'far Imam Al-Baqir (as) said:

"Whoever resides in Makkah for a year, Allah (swt) will forgive their sins, the sins of their household, everyone for whom they seek forgiveness, their relatives, and their neighbors, wiping out the sins of the past nine years. They will also be protected from all harm for 140 years."
